coordination_requests_note_check.name: coordination_requests_note_check
coordination_requests_note_check.value: "coordination_requests"."note" is null or length("coordination_requests"."note") between 1 and 500

coordination_requests_state_check.name: coordination_requests_state_check
coordination_requests_state_check.value:
("coordination_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "coordination_requests"."delivery_id" is null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_point_id" is null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_by" is null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_at" is null)
    or ("coordination_requests"."status" = 'assigned' and "coordination_requests"."delivery_id" is not null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_point_id" is not null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_by" is not null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_at" is not null)
    or ("coordination_requests"."status" = 'cancelled' and "coordination_requests"."delivery_id" is null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_point_id" is null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_by" is null and "coordination_requests"."assigned_at" is null)

deliveries_version_details_check.name: deliveries_version_details_check
deliveries_version_details_check.value:
("deliveries"."request_version" = 1 and "deliveries"."delivery_point_id" is null and "deliveries"."slot_id" is null)
    or ("deliveries"."request_version" = 2 and "deliveries"."delivery_point_id" is not null)

delivery_idempotency_completion_check.name: delivery_idempotency_completion_check
delivery_idempotency_completion_check.value:
("delivery_idempotency"."completed_at" is null and "delivery_idempotency"."delivery_id" is null)
    or ("delivery_idempotency"."completed_at" is not null and "delivery_idempotency"."delivery_id" is not null)

delivery_points_active_validated_check.name: delivery_points_active_validated_check
delivery_points_active_validated_check.value: not "delivery_points"."active" or ("delivery_points"."validation_reference" is not null and "delivery_points"."validated_by" is not null and "delivery_points"."validated_at" is not null)

delivery_slots_active_validated_check.name: delivery_slots_active_validated_check
delivery_slots_active_validated_check.value: not "delivery_slots"."active" or ("delivery_slots"."validation_reference" is not null and "delivery_slots"."validated_by" is not null and "delivery_slots"."validated_at" is not null)

point_movements_direction_check.name: point_movements_direction_check
point_movements_direction_check.value:
("point_movements"."kind" = 'delivery' and "point_movements"."delta" > 0)
    or ("point_movements"."kind" = 'redemption' and "point_movements"."delta" < 0)
    or ("point_movements"."kind"::text = 'education' and "point_movements"."delta" > 0)
    or "point_movements"."kind" = 'adjustment'

redemptions_fulfillment_check.name: redemptions_fulfillment_check
redemptions_fulfillment_check.value: ("redemptions"."fulfillment_status" = 'reserved' and "redemptions"."fulfillment_reference" is null and "redemptions"."fulfilled_by" is null and "redemptions"."fulfilled_at" is null) or ("redemptions"."fulfillment_status" = 'fulfilled' and "redemptions"."fulfillment_reference" is not null and "redemptions"."fulfilled_by" is not null and "redemptions"."fulfilled_at" is not null)

rewards_fulfillment_reference_check.name: rewards_fulfillment_reference_check
rewards_fulfillment_reference_check.value: "rewards"."fulfillment_reference" is null or length("rewards"."fulfillment_reference") between 10 and 500

rewards_active_validated_check.name: rewards_active_validated_check
rewards_active_validated_check.value: not "rewards"."active" or ("rewards"."inventory_remaining" > 0 and "rewards"."fulfillment_reference" is not null and "rewards"."validated_by" is not null and "rewards"."validated_at" is not null)

verifications_weight_check.name: verifications_weight_check
verifications_weight_check.value:
("verifications"."decision" = 'approved' and "verifications"."verified_grams" between 1 and 100000 and length("verifications"."receipt_code") between 8 and 64)
    or ("verifications"."decision" = 'rejected' and "verifications"."verified_grams" is null and "verifications"."receipt_code" is null)
